bio.text: Vince Leach is a Republican member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 17; he assumed office on January 13, 2025, and his current term ends on January 11, 2027.
He previously represented District 11 in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2015 to 2019 and in the Senate from 2019 to 2023.
He was born in Wild Rose, Wisconsin, served in the U.S. Army from 1970 to 1972, and earned a B.S. in political science and history from the University of Wisconsin, Stevens Point in 1970.
His career experience includes working as a consultant and in sales, sales management and business management.
Ballotpedia reports that he did not file to run for re-election in 2026.
